meta.note: Terms-and-relations map of the taskfw MCP tool surface: what each tool does and which skill(s) in this repo call it. Deliberately NOT part of ontology/task-domain.json -- individual tools are the interface, not domain vocabulary (that layer is already summarised as one module's promise in concept_store/concepts.json:mcp-portable-interface and its siblings). The tool set, each tool's `hooks` and every `used_by` relation are DERIVED by mcp_tools/gen_tool_graph.py from taskfw/mcp_server.py and .claude/skills/*/skill.md, and tests/test_tool_graph.py fails when the file is stale: run the script, never edit those by hand. `used_by` means the skill names the tool, not that every pass calls it. `use`, `namespaces` and `skills` are hand-written prose and are not checked for accuracy -- review `use` against the docstring when a tool's shape changes. Every tool also carries finish_nudge via _finish_hook (any result that moved a task to done). Source of truth for a tool's real signature and behavior is always taskfw/mcp_server.py.
meta.no_skill_edge: A tool with no skill edge is fine: utility and inspection tools (get, search, phase, open_in_kitty, concept__modules, concept__delete, task_memory__get) are for ad-hoc use, and the loop does not need to name them.

namespaces.tasks: Task Tracking + The Loop: create/read/update tasks, checklists, edges, commits, active-task pointer, grooming-accuracy reporting.
namespaces.concept: Architectural Knowledge: concept_store/concepts.json reads and writes, keyed by repo + module.
namespaces.task_memory: Loop Memory: MemoryRecord reads and writes, standing, and links to the tasks that confirmed/contradicted them.

skills.task-grooming: Pre-implementation pass: removes uncertainty, records falsifiable risks.
skills.task-implementation: Execution pass: stays in scope, logs decisions and commits as they happen.
skills.task-introspection: Post-implementation pass: grades grooming's predictions, promotes lessons to Loop Memory.
skills.task-framework: Entry point that starts/resumes a task and explains the lifecycle.
skills.task-skills-audit: Audits the task-* skills for drift against each other and the live tool surface.
skills.commit: Commits changes in this repo and records the commit against the active task.

tasks__context.use: The whole bundle for a task (defaults to the active task): object, decisions, grooming, graph, commits, related, lessons. `related` and `lessons` are approximate and trimmed first; `truncated` lists dropped sections.

tasks__grooming_accuracy.use: How well grooming has been predicting, across recent finished tasks.

tasks__logs.use: Operational log lines from the `logs` table, most recent first. Failures appear as `tool=<name> ERROR` inside INFO rows, so filtering level=ERROR misses them.

tasks__log_skill_invocation.use: Record that a skill was invoked, for skill-usage observability.

tasks__phase.use: Where a task stands in the grooming -> implementation -> introspection loop.

tasks__list.use: List tasks. status is comma-separated; empty means every status. Returns {tasks}, plus truncated: {limit} when rows were cut -- absent means nothing was cut.

tasks__search.use: Full-text search over titles, motivation, notes, tags, files, and checklist items. Returns {tasks}, plus truncated: {limit} when cut.

tasks__create.use: Create a task or epic AND make it the active task, replacing whatever was active (the start of a loop pass; nothing auto-clears it). Carries loop_debt_nudge. Response has advisory related_candidates; it never creates an edge.

tasks__update.use: Update a task; only passed fields change, each replace-not-append. `grooming` is typed and merges per key ([] clears a key); risks merge by id. `scope` corrects the project and leaves a note event. Carries finish_reminder_nudge and ungroomed_progress_nudge.

tasks__check_item.use: Tick or untick one checklist item by zero-based index. Ticking the last open item finishes the task like tasks__finish (carries finish_nudge); does not touch the active pointer. Carries finish_reminder_nudge and ungroomed_progress_nudge.

tasks__finish.use: Mark a task done. Carries finish_nudge when no introspection report exists yet. Leaves the active pointer where it is.

tasks__add_introspection.use: Append a typed introspection report (unknown keys refused, free text in `other`, empty refused, identical retry a no-op with duplicate: true). Clears the active pointer when the task is the active one (active_cleared) -- the only deactivation path. Carries introspection_nudge when lessons were reported with no memory cited.

tasks__add_decision.use: Record a design decision, shown in tasks__context. `resolves` ticks that checklist item in the same call (may finish the task). Carries finish_reminder_nudge and ungroomed_progress_nudge.

tasks__link.use: Create an edge between two tasks. Idempotent.

tasks__unlink.use: Remove an edge, or every edge between two tasks when rel is omitted.

tasks__edges.use: Edges touching a task, both directions.

tasks__format_commit_message.use: Format a commit message in the canonical shape: `task:<id> subject`, blank, body.

tasks__add_commit.use: Record that a commit implemented a task. Idempotent.

tasks__set_active.use: Set the in-memory active-task pointer, replacing any previous one; not persisted. Carries loop_debt_nudge / task_debt_nudge and ungroomed_start_nudge when the task was never groomed.

tasks__open_in_kitty.use: Open a task in a kitty tab via `kitty-taskfw open`; fail-soft, returns opened / exists / not_opened with a reason.

tasks__active.use: The active task for this workspace, if any, plus server.stale (loaded vs current git sha). In-memory only.

concept__list.use: Architectural concepts for a repo, optionally filtered to one module.

concept__modules.use: Every module that has at least one concept.

concept__search.use: Substring search over name, module, description, contracts, and invariants.

concept__delete.use: Remove a concept. Returns deleted=False when it was not there.

concept__uncovered.use: Which of the given modules have no concept -- the coverage check.

task_memory__record.use: Record a lesson from a finished task. kind: constraint | technique | pitfall.

task_memory__recall.use: Search loop memories (omit query to list recent). Superseded excluded; each result carries a derived standing. Carries truncated: {limit} when more matched.

task_memory__get.use: One memory by slug, including its standing and every task linked to it.

task_memory__link.use: Record that a task confirmed_by / contradicted_by / learned_from a memory. Idempotent. Carries stale_memory_nudge.

task_memory__supersede.use: Mark a memory obsolete, naming the memory that replaced it.

task_memory__forget.use: Delete a memory outright -- for one that was WRONG, not merely outdated.
